# usageregistry_record Resource

Records that a consumer uses a target. `consumer.sub_id` optionally distinguishes multiple records that use the same target and consumer ID.

The provider stores one source-of-truth item plus compact target and consumer search references. Create and delete update the source and search String Sets in one transaction. Mutable payload updates use the source item's `version` for compare-and-swap concurrency control.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "usageregistry_target_type" "vault_secret" {
  name    = "vault_secret"
  actions = ["read"]
}

resource "usageregistry_consumer_type" "repository" {
  name = "repository"
}

resource "usageregistry_record" "vault_secret" {
  target {
    type   = "vault_secret"
    id     = "kv/secret-source/common/db"
    action = "read"
  }

  consumer {
    type   = "repository"
    id     = "https://git.projectbro.com/Devops/example-service"
    sub_id = "prod"
  }

  annotations = {
    ownership = "platform"
  }
}
```

The source key is `target#<target.type>#<target.id>` and `consumer#<consumer.type>#<consumer.id>[#sub_id#<consumer.sub_id>]`. Import ID formats are:

```text
record#<target_type>#<target_id>#<consumer_type>#<consumer_id>
record#<target_type>#<target_id>#<consumer_type>#<consumer_id>#sub_id#<sub_id>
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `consumer` (Block, exactly one) Consumer using the target.
- `target` (Block, exactly one) Target resource being used.

### Optional

- `annotations` (Map of String) Additional string annotations stored with the usage record.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the record was created.
- `id` (String) Stable importable record identifier.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the record was last updated.
- `version` (Number) DynamoDB-backed record version used for compare-and-swap updates.

### Nested Schema for `target`

Required:

- `action` (String) Action performed against the target. Must be allowed by the registered target type.
- `id` (String) Provider-defined target identifier. Must match the target type's `id_regex` when configured.
- `type` (String) Registered target type name.

Optional:

- `version` (String) `latest` when omitted, otherwise a target-specific version.

### Nested Schema for `consumer`

Required:

- `id` (String) Provider-defined consumer identifier. Must match the consumer type's `id_regex` when configured.
- `type` (String) Registered consumer type name.

Optional:

- `sub_id` (String) Distinguishes multiple usage records with the same consumer ID. Must not be empty or contain `#`, and must match the consumer type's `sub_id_regex` when configured.
